dict.string: Driveby connects to an optional OBD-II Bluetooth adapter to read your car's real fuel use, which validates the efficiency score.
Driveby uses the camera as a dashcam — every face and licence plate is blurred on your phone before anything is saved — and to scan your paper driving log.
Driveby keeps recording speed and location if your phone locks during a drive you started, so the drive isn't cut short.
Driveby uses your location and speed during a drive to score braking, acceleration, cornering and speed, and to show your route.
Lets you save a blurred event clip to your Photos when you share it.
